notes: Inbound SMB lead: small ecommerce startup (niche floral subscription). Primary pain: customer-facing chat widget in EU with slow responses. Quote from CTO: "Users in Germany see 700-900ms TTFB, that's killing conversion." They signed up self-serve and tried default setup; integration currently pins requests to us-east-1. Wants low-friction fixes before committing. Key asks: region selection for hosted API, guidance on client-side timeouts, and recommendations to reduce per-request latency/cost. SE findings: long system prompt + full convo history being sent every request (excess tokens). Recommended quick wins: 1) set region param to eu-west-1 in SDK, 2) enable streaming (reduces perceived latency), 3) trim system prompt and only send last N turns or use embeddings for retrieval, 4) bump client timeout from 10s -> 30s for longer summarization jobs and use streaming for chat, 5) enable response cache for frequent identical prompts, 6) consider compact model variant for micro-interactions. Customer is price sensitive; wants hosted API (self-serve) not dedicated.
